major_work.title: Point-in-Time News Lead/Lag Impact Attribution Graph
major_work.problem: Current issue importance explicitly leaves market_reaction_component=PENDING, while importance is driven by publisher/article/channel/official/recency counts. A high article count or many publishers can therefore rank an issue before evidence shows that price, flow, rates, FX, oil, futures or sector breadth actually reacted.
major_work.hypothesis: A point-in-time event graph that separates pre-event drift, immediate reaction, delayed confirmation and reversal across market/flow/macro channels can reduce false-positive important-news rankings versus count/recency scoring, without claiming causality when chronology or controls are insufficient.

event_time_contract.t0: earliest trustworthy published_at/official release timestamp available as-of decision time; never observed_at when a reliable earlier publication timestamp exists
abstain_rules: major confounding event without usable control

scoring_challenger.principle: Article volume is discovery evidence, not market-impact proof.
scoring_challenger.hard_rule: PENDING/UNKNOWN market reaction contributes zero positive confirmation and cannot be converted into impact by article count alone.
scoring_challenger.anti_double_count: Correlated channels sharing the same upstream evidence fingerprint are grouped before confidence aggregation.

validation_contract: compare precision of top-ranked issues and false-positive rate
no threshold tuning on final test
falsification_contract: test whether official source was actually available as-of t0
reject causal wording when only contemporaneous correlation exists
major_work.sre_handoff: Only after validation demand is established, persist aligned point-in-time news/market/flow snapshots and freshness metadata; do not build a new production path solely for this hypothesis.
kill_criteria: no OOS precision/false-positive improvement over current ranking
timestamp alignment cannot be made point-in-time safe
abstention destroys useful coverage without reducing error
regime labels are unstable or leak future information

evidence.observed_gap: issue-digest importance_components show market_reaction_component=PENDING while ranking already assigns positive publisher/article/channel/recency components

small_works.finding: Current clustering mutates the union token set and derives fingerprint from that final set; this matches the prior stable-identity challenger fingerprint, so NO_NEW_EVIDENCE for that architecture and no duplicate candidate was created.

independent_publishers is currently distinct publisher count, not proven independent-origin count; this matches the prior source-independence challenger fingerprint, so it is handed off rather than re-designed here.

Pages market-news.json is generated from src/kmb_lab/pages.py and is not a canonical source file; UX experiments should consume candidate evidence without changing production schema before validation.
